jobs.title: Safety & Security Lead
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About Careem

Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East, making it easier than ever to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Careem is led by a powerful purpose to simplify and improve the lives of people and build an awesome organisation that inspires. Since 2012, Careem has created earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of over 50 million customers, and built a platform for the region’s best talent to thrive and for entrepreneurs to scale their businesses.

About the role

The safety and security of our Captains, customers and colleagues is paramount to Careem’s mission and is a strategic priority. As a Safety lead, you will be at the heart of our day to day safety operations, ensuring that every safety incident involving Captains or customers is handled with speed, care and consistency. You will execute safety processes on the ground, coordinate incident response end to end, and work closely with internal teams to make Careem the safest platform in the region.

What you'll do

  • Safety Operations Execution: Run day to day safety operations in line with established policies and standard operating procedures, ensuring consistent and timely handling of all safety matters affecting Captains and customers.
  • Incident Response and Case Management: Act as the first point of coordination for safety incidents. Triage, log and manage cases from intake through resolution, ensuring accurate documentation, timely escalations and closure within defined SLAs.
  • Captain and Customer Support: Follow up with Captains and customers involved in safety incidents, providing empathetic support, coordinating assistance where needed, and ensuring their concerns are resolved end to end.
  • Investigations Support: Lead investigations into safety related issues, and summarize findings for senior stakeholders.
  • Reporting and Data Quality: Maintain accurate incident records and trackers, prepare regular safety reports and dashboards, and highlight trends, gaps and recurring issues to the leadership team.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve safety processes and tools based on frontline observations, and support the rollout of new safety initiatives, campaigns and training across all markets.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

At Careem, our journey started with a simple purpose: to simplify and improve the lives of people in the Greater Middle East. From our beginnings as a ride-hailing service, we’ve grown into the region’s first Everything App, but our mission remains the same. We’re not just a tech company; we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers, working to create a better future for our region.

Your expertise is exactly what’s needed to shape the future of engineering culture and technical foundations in the region.

  • Lead Internal Engineering Initiatives: Personally design and build scalable, secure, and maintainable systems that accelerate engineering productivity and reliability across Careem.

  • Drive Impact in Data & AI: Apply machine learning, platformization, and agentic AI innovation to unlock new capabilities and improve customer experiences at scale.
  • Product Mindset & Technical Influence: Shape roadmaps and drive technical decisions with a product-centric mindset, ensuring solutions directly impact customer and business outcomes.

jobs.description: • Inspect and verify all construction materials delivered to site to ensure compliance with RTA specifications, approved material submittals, and contract requirements . • Check material source approvals, delivery notes, batch certificates, and test reports prior to acceptance and use at site. • Carry out sampling and witnessing of laboratory and field tests for soil, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, steel, and other civil materials as per approved ITPs. • Ensure materials used for roadworks, bridges, culverts, drainage, and utility works conform to approved specifications and drawings. • Monitor storage, handling, and protection of materials to prevent contamination, segregation, or damage. • Verify compliance with RTA-approved suppliers, manufacturers, and testing laboratories . • Coordinate with the Material Engineer and Site Engineer regarding testing schedules, approvals, and material-related issues. • Inspect asphalt paving, concrete works, earthworks, and backfilling to ensure correct materials and workmanship are used. • Review and submit Work Inspection Requests (WIRs) related to materials and civil works. • Maintain accurate inspection records, test results, and material logs for QA/QC and as-built documentation. • Identify non-conforming materials, raise NCRs and site observations , and follow up on corrective actions. • Ensure compliance with HSE requirements , especially during material handling, sampling, and testing activities. • Monitor material usage and quantities to avoid wastage, misuse, or deviation from approved specifications . • Assist in RTA inspections and audits , providing required documentation and site support. • Report daily site activities, material inspections, and testing status to the Material Engineer / Resident Engineer .   Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering or Diploma Holders with relevant education background RTA or DM Approval holder is must

jobs.title: Land Surveyor (Roads and Infrastructure)
jobs.description: We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Land Surveyor specializing in Roads and Infrastructure to join our dynamic team in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy and compliance of all survey activities on infrastructure projects. You will work closely with engineering teams, contractors, and client representatives to verify that all construction works meet approved specifications and design requirements. Your expertise in setting-out, topographic surveys, and as-built documentation will be essential in maintaining the highest standards of quality and precision throughout project execution. Review and understand project contract documents, drawings, specifications, and relevant authority standards to ensure accurate survey execution and compliance with design requirements. Establish, verify, and maintain primary horizontal and vertical control points on site, including reference benchmarks and traverse networks. Coordinate with the Contractor’s surveyor to verify site benchmarks, layout, and control data prior to commencement of construction activities. Check and verify all setting-out works including alignment, levels, and coordinates for roads, utilities (wet and dry), structures, and other civil works to ensure accuracy and compliance with approved drawings. ·Monitor excavation levels, backfilling, and compaction layers to ensure compliance with approved design grades and tolerances. Inspect and confirm the correct installation of utilities, chambers, and ducts based on approved survey data and ensure correct cover levels and horizontal alignment. Conduct topographic and as-built surveys, ensuring data accuracy and proper submission of as-built drawings for approval. Verify survey instruments are properly calibrated and maintained as per project and QA/QC requirements. Assist the Resident Engineer (RE) and Assistant Resident Engineer (ARE) in checking the contractor’s survey works, identifying discrepancies, and issuing site instructions as required. Record and document survey data, prepare survey reports, and maintain field books for all inspection and verification activities. Ensure the contractor’s survey team follows approved method statements and safety procedures during survey activities. Perform joint surveys with the contractor and client representatives for measurement verification, payment quantities, and handover purposes. Ensure all utilities and structures are constructed to correct levels and alignments before covering or backfilling works. Participate in resolving survey-related issues or conflicts on site, including interface coordination between different packages or contractors. Report any discrepancies, deviations, or errors found in the contractor’s setting out to the RE/ARE immediately. Monitor Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) compliance during survey activities and report any unsafe practices observed on site.    Minimum 7 years of professional surveying experience in roads and infrastructure projects Proven experience in construction site survey activities and verification Demonstrated experience coordinating with contractors and multiple stakeholders Experience in utility installation verification and structural survey work Experience conducting joint surveys and measurement verification activities Familiarity with Dubai and UAE construction standards and regulatory requirements RTA Approval preferred

jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

This role leads the growth function for Careem Food in Dubai and, by extension, UAE. The Manager owns bottom-up planning, tracks performance against plan, designs and program manages growth initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment. This person is the primary bridge between the growth team and the commercial organisation, with direct accountability for ensuring Food hits its revenue targets in the market.

What you’ll do

Growth Planning & Bottom-Up Strategy

    • Own the bottom-up growth plan for Dubai/UAE – translating market opportunity into measurable targets across MAUs, OPU, ARPU, and revenue.
    • Build and maintain the quarterly and annual growth roadmap, ensuring tight alignment with organisational revenue goals.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

    • Own the performance rhythm for Dubai/UAE: weekly/monthly plan vs. actuals reviews, funnel health checks, and initiative-level tracking.
    • Build and maintain dashboards that surface the health of key growth metrics across the customer funnel.
    • Proactively diagnose gaps vs. plan, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions at pace.

Commercial Partnership & Revenue Accountability

    • Act as the primary growth point of contact for the Food commercial team – ensuring growth and commercial plans are tightly integrated.
    • Co-own revenue target delivery with the commercial team; design offers, incentives, and promotions that balance growth outcomes with unit economics.

Initiative Design & Execution

    • Design growth initiatives end-to-end across user acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetisation.
    • Lead A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to iterate and optimize initiatives across channels.

Program Management

    • Own the execution cadence for the Dubai/UAE growth portfolio: scoping, resourcing, launch timelines, and post-launch measurement.
    • Ensure initiatives are delivered on time with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
    • Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively escalate blockers to leadership.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

    • Align Product, Engineering, Operations, and Marketing around the Dubai/UAE growth agenda.
    • Communicate growth performance and strategy clearly to senior stakeholders and leadership.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Senior Site Architect

Responsibilities Lead the supervision of all architectural works on high-rise construction projects, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and applicable codes. Manage and coordinate the activities of Architects, Inspectors, and other site supervision personnel to ensure consistent quality and technical compliance. Review and approve shop drawings, material submittals, mock-ups, method statements, Requests for Information (RFIs), and architectural design clarifications. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Planning
jobs.description: We are seeking a seasoned Project Planning/Project Controls Engineer to lead schedule and cost controls across complex infrastructure and buildings programs.You will shape robust baselines, drive project performance, and provide clear insights that help our clients make confident decisions. Ensure project schedules comply with RTA specifications, guidelines, and standard work breakdown structures (WBS) for roads, bridges, and infrastructure projects. Coordinate planning activities in line with RTA approval procedures, including interim milestones, traffic staging, and sectional handover requirements. Monitor and integrate RTA authority approvals (NOCs, permits, traffic diversion approvals, utility coordination) into the project schedule. Review and assess contractors’ programs against RTA contractual milestones, key performance indicators (KPIs), and phasing requirements. Develop, review, and maintain detailed project schedules (baseline, recovery, and revised programs) using Primavera P6 or equivalent planning software. Prepare master schedules, look-ahead programs, and weekly/monthly progress reports in coordination with project teams. Monitor project progress against the approved baseline and identify delays, risks, and critical path impacts. Perform schedule risk analysis, delay analysis, and time impact analysis (TIA) in accordance with contract requirements. Coordinate with construction, procurement, design, and commercial teams to ensure alignment between schedule, resources, and deliverables. Review contractors’ planning submissions, method statements, and manpower histograms for compliance with contract specifications. Support the Project Manager/Resident Engineer by providing planning inputs for decision-making and corrective actions. Prepare and evaluate EOT (Extension of Time) claims, substantiating delays with proper planning narratives and evidence. Track procurement, long-lead items, approvals, and permits to ensure schedule compliance. Develop recovery and mitigation plans to bring delayed activities back on track. Conduct weekly and monthly planning meetings with stakeholders and issue meeting minutes related to schedule actions. Ensure integration of cost, cash flow, and resource-loaded schedules where required. Maintain proper documentation and ensure planning records comply with project controls and QA/QC procedures. Provide mentoring and guidance to junior planning engineers and site planners. Liaise with clients, consultants, and authorities on all schedule-related matters. Support project close-out by preparing as-built programs and final planning reports. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field (Master’s preferred). Senior planning/controls role requiring 15+ years’ experience, strong base cost and standard planning capability, consultancy and local market experience, and a proven track record across infrastructure and buildings. Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6, cost control, EVM, risk analysis, and executive‑quality reporting is essential. Client‑facing leadership, clear communication, and rigorous governance will be central to success.

Careem Grocery is reinventing how people shop for groceries, pharmacy, and everyday essentials, on-demand, in minutes. If a process can be automated, you'll be the one to build the case and execute it.
  • Insight & Communication - Translate complex demand signals into clear narratives for senior leadership. Forecast updates, variance analysis, risk flags — you own the story and the numbers behind it.

jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.

This role sits within the Rides Product team, which leads product strategy and delivery for the Rides vertical to simplify mobility for customers. You will play a critical role ensuring complex programmes land on time, to a high standard, and with full visibility across the organisation — including across third-party integration boundaries.

What you'll do

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, data analysts, commercial leaders, and operations teams to conceptualise cross-functional initiatives with layered dependencies and plan their execution
  • Organise and align multiple stakeholders — including third-party partners — to drive timely, accountable execution
  • Develop a solid understanding of the technical architecture to exercise sound judgment on risks, trade-offs, and cross-team dependencies
  • Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation
  • Lead incident coordination, post-mortems, and closure of action items to build systemic resilience over time
  • Own go-live orchestration for major launches — including rollout gates, rollback triggers, and cross-functional readiness sign-offs
  • Track and flag resourcing risks to support delivery pace and quality
  • Maintain the programme's source of truth: decision logs, dependency registers, and status documentation
